quest.title: Whispers in the Wind
quest.description: Glory misses her boyfriend who went on a long journey. She's looking for a way to carry her words to him.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: ...Godwin... When will you return...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hi...

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: I know that voice— Why, if it isn't the Traveler from afar! Thanks be to the great Anemo Archon, for he surely sent the wind to guide you to this place... I have a request for you.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: My— um, boyfriend, Godwin — he's in the Knights of Favonius you know — he left the city ages ago and still hasn't come back.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: I haven't heard a single word from him since he's been gone.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: I'm so worried about him. Poor Godwin, what if he runs into those nasty hilichurls? Or, or he also said they're at war with the Abyss Order, what if he gets injured? And... and now he's been away so long, what if he takes a liking to one of the pretty knight girls...

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: ...Argh, sorry! Sorry, I—I'm getting carried away. My mother always tells me that dandelions can carry people's heart's desires far away to a distant place.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: So, my request is... could you collect three Dandelion Seeds from Windrise for me?

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: Thank you ever so much! May the Anemo Archon protect you.

choices.text: I have more important things to do.

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: Wait! I beg you, please help me. Surely this should be a piece of cake for a seasoned Traveler like you...

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Did you do it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was so windy up there...

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Good, that's what we want. That way the Dandelion Seeds can travel far away.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Maybe they really will reach Godwin after all, and pass on what I want to say to him.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Give me your hand... Here, take these. These are to say thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: There is still so much more I want to say to Godwin. I may need your help again in future.

talks.objective: Give the Dandelion Seeds to Glory

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Welcome back, did you get my Dandelion Seeds?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Thank you! Can you please place them into my hand? I can't see, and I'll lose them otherwise.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will these be enough?

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Could you place them into my hand? That's the only way I can tell.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: This is enough. Now to tell them everything I want to say to Godwin...

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: ...Erm, cover your ears please. No eavesdropping! These are private words shared between lovers. You know... *giggle* You must have had a similar experience before?

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Okay, I'm done. Now, take these to the top of the Anemo Archon statue and release them into the wind. The great archon himself will take them from there.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: I hope he will guide them to Godwin.

talks.objective: Go to the top of the Anemo Archon statue and scatter the Dandelion Seeds
